name: Leaflet Maps
description: Draws a map of pins (clustered, with a fullscreen button) from OpenStreetMap tiles using a bundled Leaflet, for a theme to place anywhere - no API key, no cookies

setup.postInstallNote:
Add once on any page that shows a map (it loads Leaflet's CSS and JS). Then place a map with
, where JSON is {"pins":[{"lat":51.5,"lng":-0.12,"title":"Name","text":"Details","url":"https://...","inactive":false}],"height":"400px","fullscreen":true}. title, text, url, inactive, height and fullscreen are optional. Build the JSON with htmlspecialchars(json_encode(...), ENT_QUOTES). Tiles load from openstreetmap.org when a visitor views a map.
